questions.question: The Constitution was amended (52nd Amendment) to introduce the Anti-Defection Law primarily to prevent:
options: Voters from casting negative votes in elections
New political parties from registering with the Election Commission
Judges from hearing election petition cases
Elected MLAs and MPs from changing parties after being elected in order to become ministers or for cash payoffs
questions.explanation: The 52nd Constitutional Amendment, 1985, added the Tenth Schedule to address political defections. Disqualification applies on specified grounds, including voluntarily giving up party membership or voting/abstaining contrary to a party direction without prior permission and without condonation within 15 days; a qualifying merger is an exception.

Allowing party presidents to appoint their sons as permanent successors
Making party manifestos legally enforceable under criminal treason laws

questions.subtopic: Quality of Democracy and Public Involvement
questions.question: Ultimately, the quality of a democracy and the responsiveness of its political parties depends on:
options: The total amount of gold held in the central bank
The degree of public participation; democracy cannot be improved if ordinary citizens merely criticize from outside without joining politics
The length of constitutional textbooks taught in schools
The speed of supersonic jet fighters owned by the military
questions.explanation: The quality of democracy depends on the degree of public participation. It is difficult to reform politics if ordinary citizens do not take part in it and simply criticise it from the outside. The problem of bad politics can be solved by more politics and better politics.
